ops3_rule: This backlog projects the approved CNI family. Current selection and implementation authority come only from operations/CURRENT.json; cross-program activation is governed by ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json.

tranches.name: Content Pack Manifest, Component Identity & Typed Payload Contract
Executable Dialogue Graph & Governed Action Binding
Quest/Scene Progression, One-Shot, Delay & Re-entry Triggers
Cross-Pack Extension, Patch Hook & Conflict Detection
Localization Resource Separation & Stable Text Keys
Dry-Run Apply, Validation, Transactional Activation & Rollback Receipt
Creator Pack / Narrative Inspector & Dependency Graph

boundaries: CNI does not become canonical Story or owner-domain state authority
dialogue and triggers bind to governed Actions/Events instead of directly mutating owner state
CNI packs reference ARI resource identity/rights rather than duplicating the resource library
PCA-10 may provide visual authoring over CNI contracts but cannot replace the CNI runtime or narrative owners
CNI-10 establishes localizable content structure but SMB-16 owns final product-wide localization completion
Candlekeep Revisited is a pattern-study source only; no direct copyrighted content or unlicensed code reuse is authorized
CNI-01 is completed_verified; CNI-02 is selected_not_started with no implementation branch or authority; CNI-03+ remain unauthorized
ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json may make PCA milestone-eligible after CNI-02, but eligibility does not itself select or authorize PCA
